purpose: Teach: マッチ/アホ/佐々木/岐阜/さぁ/たまる/珠/うめ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃんはマッチでタバコに火をつけてらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your grandfather was young, he'd light his cigarettes with matches.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Slow, deliberate pacing. Voice carries affection and a kind of tender wonder at the small details of a life lived together long ago.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ご自分のことアホとおっしゃってお笑いになったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, he used to call himself foolish and laugh about it, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, fond recollection. Gentle rhythm, like sharing a beloved story. Slight lift at the end as she draws him into the shared memory. Intimacy in the familiarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、佐々木さんとよくお話されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, he used to talk with Sasaki often.
lines.style: Quieter, almost to himself. Each phrase settles like a photograph being placed down. Warm but reverential — the voice of someone sitting with old joy.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、岐阜のご親戚にお会いになったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He visited your relatives in Gifu, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation, like she's filling in the frame he's started. Calm, knowing tone. The 'dear' lands with quiet affection, tethering them both in the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、さぁ行こうとよく仰ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, he'd often say 'Come on, let's go.'
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on the remembered phrase — almost like he's hearing it again. Slower delivery. The words carry weight and longing. Fade gently at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、貯金がたまるのを楽しみにされてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He used to look forward to watching his savings grow, didn't he?
lines.style: A small, knowing smile in her voice. Steady, warm. She's seeing him again — his practical hopes, his simple joy. The rhythm is patient, like she has all the time in the world.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ばあさんの珠のような瞳が綺麗だったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your eyes were as beautiful as pearls.
lines.style: Direct, unguarded tenderness. The words come slowly, deliberately. His voice softens on 'pearls' — a man speaking across decades to the woman he loved. Vulnerability held carefully.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うめぼし、美味しいよね。お祖父ちゃん、お庭で梅をご覧になったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Pickled plums are delicious, aren't they? He used to look at the plum tree in the garden, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: A gentle shift — her mind follows his into another small moment. Warm and slightly breathy on the beginning. Soft, close intimacy in her voice, like she's speaking half to him and half to the memory itself.
